Turrets that fire guns from [TACZ](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/timeless-and-classics-zero). Give a turret a TACZ gun and some ammo, and it will fire at enemies.

## Dependencies
[TACZ](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/timeless-and-classics-zero)
[GeckoLib](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib)
[SmartBrainLib](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/smartbrainlib)
[Architectury API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/architectury-api)

## Controls

- **Place it** by right-clicking a block. Use the bottom of a block to hang the turret upside down from the ceiling, or the side of a block to mount it on a wall.
- **Open it** by right-clicking the turret. Put a gun in the gun slot, ammo in the slots below it, and a TACZ laser sight next to the gun slot.
- **Pick it up** by crouching and right-clicking. You get the turret back with its gun, laser and ammo.
- **Paint it** by crouching and right-clicking with a dye or a banner. A dye recolors the turret's panels, and a banner puts its design on each panel. The paint stays on the turret when you pick it up. Crouch and right-click with an axe to scrape it off.
- **Camo it** the same way with a camo from the Camos tab of the Turret Workbench. A camo covers the whole turret except its status light. Scraping it off with an axe removes it.
- **Repair it** by right-clicking with iron bars.

A turret standing on a chest, barrel or any other item storage takes matching ammo from it when it runs out.

## GUI

- **Power**: Always On, Redstone On, Redstone Off or Always Off.
- **Mode**: Aggressive fires as fast as the gun allows. Conservative spaces its shots out to save ammo. Adaptive saves ammo at range and switches to Aggressive when a target gets close.
- **Players**: Never Target, Retaliate (only players who hurt it) or Always Target. Allies are never targeted.
- **Allies**: click an online player in the list to make them an ally of the owner, and click again to remove them.

The status light shows what the turret is doing:

| Light | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Green | Ready |
| Yellow | Reloading |
| Bright red | Out of ammo |
| Dark red | No gun |
| Gray | Switched off |

## Allies

Turrets do not target their owner or the owner's allies. Allies come from:

- the allies list in the turret screen
- `/turret trust <players>`, `/turret untrust <players>` and `/turret trusted`
- vanilla teams
- FTB Teams parties and allies.
- Open Parties and Claims parties and allied parties.
- Villager Recruits factions and allied factions (1.20.1). Turrets will not target your recruits.

Allies can also open and manage your turrets. Turn that off with `alliesHavePerms`.

## Turrets

Turrets are crafted at the Turret Workbench.

Sniper guns double a turret's range.

The Brass turret is for the [Create](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create) mod and requires rotational power. It fires slower at low rotation speeds and reaches its full fire rate at 64 RPM.

The Steel turret is for the [Immersive Engineering](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/immersive-engineering) mod.

The Basic, Advanced, Elite and Ultimate turrets are for the [Mekanism](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mekanism) mod.

Each turret uses the stats below. Fire rate stats are off by default and need `fireRateStats`. Turn on `identicalTurrets` to give them all the Modern turret's stats and recipe.

| Turret | Health | Armor | Range | Reload | Fire rate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Scrap | 120 | 2 | 48 | 1x | 0.8x |
| Modern | 200 | 6 | 64 | 1x | 1x |
| Industrial | 300 | 10 | 56 | 1.1x | 0.9x |
| Tactical | 220 | 8 | 72 | 1.25x | 1.15x |
| Brass | 200 | 6 | 64 | 1x | 1x |
| Steel | 200 | 6 | 64 | 1x | 1x |
| Basic | 200 | 6 | 64 | 1x | 1x |
| Advanced | 250 | 8 | 72 | 1.1x | 1.05x |
| Elite | 300 | 10 | 80 | 1.2x | 1.1x |
| Ultimate | 400 | 14 | 96 | 1.35x | 1.2x |

## Sentry Turrets

Sentry turrets have no owner and are meant for structures. When one spawns, it rolls a loadout that picks its turret type, gun, laser, camo and ammo. Hostile sentries shoot players on sight, and neutral ones only shoot back.

- Only operators and creative players can open, pick up, paint or repair a sentry.
- Sentries don't need power and don't shoot players on Peaceful.
- A destroyed sentry drops a few of its turret's crafting materials, any ammo it had left, and sometimes its gun.

### Sentry Turret Loadouts

Loadouts are datapack files in `data/<namespace>/sentry_loadouts/`. A sentry with no loadout, or one that doesn't exist, uses `tacz_turrets:default`:

```json
{
  "hostile": true,
  "guns": [
    {"type": "rifle", "weight": 4},
    {"type": "smg", "weight": 3},
    {"type": "shotgun", "weight": 2},
    {"type": "mg", "weight": 1}
  ],
  "laser_chance": 0.25,
  "paint_chance": 0.6,
  "range": 32,
  "gun_drop_chance": 0.1
}
```

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `types` | all | Turret types to pick from: `modern`, `industrial`, `scrap`, `tactical`, `brass` (Create), `steel` (Immersive Engineering), `basic`, `advanced`, `elite`, `ultimate` (Mekanism). Mod addon turrets only spawn when `moddedSentryTurrets` is on. |
| `hostile` | `true` | `true` shoots players on sight, `false` only shoots back. |
| `guns` | required | Weighted list. An entry names a gun (`"gun": "tacz:ak47"`), a TACZ gun type (`"type": "rifle"`), or neither for any gun. |
| `ammo` | infinite | Rounds it spawns with, as `{"min": 60, "max": 180}`. Leave it out for infinite ammo. |
| `laser_chance` | `0` | Chance of a random TACZ laser. |
| `paint_chance` | `0` | Chance of a camo, dye or banner. |
| `paints` | biome | Camos, dyes or banners. Each sentry gets one of them. Leave it out to pick a camo for the biome, using the biome tags `tacz_turrets:camo/<camo>`. |
| `range` | `32` | Range in blocks. |
| `gun_drop_chance` | `0.1` | Chance the gun drops when a player destroys the sentry. |
| `laser_drop_chance` | `0` | Chance the laser drops when a player destroys the sentry. |

TACZ's default gun types are `pistol`, `smg`, `rifle`, `shotgun`, `sniper`, `mg` and `rpg`.

Each sentry gets one entry from `paints`, picked at random. An entry is an item id, like `"tacz_turrets:desert_camo"` or `"minecraft:yellow_dye"`, or a banner with patterns:

```json
"paints": [
  {"banner": "black", "patterns": [{"pattern": "minecraft:skull", "color": "white"}]}
]
```

### Sentry Turret Spawns

Spawn rules are datapack files in `data/<namespace>/sentry_spawns/`. A spawn rule places sentries in structures, on the surface, or in caves. Surface and cave spawns are off by default and can be turned on with the `surfaceSentrySpawns` and `caveSentrySpawns` configs.

```json
{
  "where": "structure",
  "structures": ["minecraft:pillager_outpost"],
  "loadout": "tacz_turrets:default",
  "count": {"min": 2, "max": 4},
  "ceiling_chance": 0.2,
  "wall_chance": 0.2
}
```

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `where` | required | `structure`, `surface` or `cave`. |
| `structures` | all | Structure ids or `#tags` the rule applies to. Only for `structure`. |
| `biomes` | all | Biome ids or `#tags` sentries can spawn in. |
| `loadout` | `tacz_turrets:default` | The loadout the sentries spawn with. |
| `chance` | `1` | Chance per structure, or per chunk for `surface` and `cave`. |
| `count` | `1` | Sentries per structure or chunk, as `{"min": 1, "max": 3}`. |
| `ceiling_chance` | `0` | Chance a sentry hangs from a ceiling. Only for `structure` and `cave`. |
| `wall_chance` | `0` | Chance a sentry is mounted on a wall. Only for `structure` and `cave`. The two chances together can't go over `1`, the rest spawn on the floor. |

## Config

- Server: How turrets and sentry turrets target, fight, use ammo and take damage, plus each turret type's stats. Each turret type can be set to need power with `requirePower`.
- Client: How turrets look on your screen, such as health bar style and color.

The entity tags `tacz_turrets:turret_targets` and `tacz_turrets:turret_ignored` can be used for what turrets will or will not target.

## Building

Both versions build with this [Stonecutter](https://stonecutter.kikugie.dev/) project. With JDK 21:

```
./gradlew chiseledBuild
```

The jars will be in `build/libs/<version>/`.
